title: Southbound
style: Whimsical travel adventure - a soaring flute and accordion 'flock theme', a lonely solo piano for Stripe, a plodding bassoon for the pigeon, and a warm marimba and steel-pan finale on the island.
rules: Original instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no spoken word.

hit_points.cue: Flute and accordion flock theme bursts in on the door pop.
The flock theme fades into the distance; solo piano.
Piano lifts into a brave little rising line.
Bassoon and flute play together for the first time.
Full flock theme returns on flute, accordion and strings.
Marimba and steel pan join the theme.
Solo piano returns over soft steel pan.
Flock theme slows into a tender final statement; final G major chord at the cut.

end_card.cue: Music resolves on the final chord exactly at the cut; ODDLY sting plays over 2.0s end card.
